docs.purpose: Lets a signed-in subscriber open the payment provider's self-service billing portal, where they can cancel their subscription, update their payment method, or fix a failed payment — replacing the static billing-page link the mobile app used before.
docs.data_story: It reads 1 table — `user_profiles` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `mobile/src/hooks/usePortalSession.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `COMMAND`. It declares the JOB it triggers (`job_ref`), its concurrency posture and the audit row it must write. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.
